data.text: Board on Anders' Mac (/dev/cu.usbmodem2101) is running Leo's office_station firmware (195cea1). Verified live 2026-11-05: btn_kitchen press/release events (3 of 3 presses), and office_say, led_kitchen_fill, led_aux_fill and speaker_play_rtttl all acknowledged. Sensors are streaming: co2_co2 ~1091 ppm, aht20 ~29 °C / 25 %, distance. Visual confirmation of the screen/LED/speaker output is still pending from Anders.
